work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CLVII congratulates Grand Duke Leopold II on the birth of a son; address, intitulation, body and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF30567–30567; the source dating clause at LF30604–30607 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima maii millesimo octin- gentesimo quadragesimo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
